summary: Music streaming project with Jamendo + Free Music Archive integration, search, favorites, and playlists. Recurring issue with tracks not loading.
architectural_notes: Music section uses Jamendo API + Free Music Archive; must include hardcoded fallback tracks in case APIs fail or return empty results
known_issues: 'No tracks available' error shown repeatedly — Jamendo/FMA APIs returning empty or failing; fix by using CORS-friendly endpoints and curated fallback tracks

existing_features.title: Rewrite the music API service to use the Jamendo public API with a correct, CORS-friendly endpoint (e.g., https://api.jamendo.com/v3.0/tracks/ with client_id param) and proper query parameters so it reliably returns tracks. Ensure the fetch includes required fields: id, name, artist_name, audio (streaming URL), album_image, genre tags. Remove any FMA (Free Music Archive) dependency as it is unreliable.

Add a curated set of at least 20 hardcoded fallback tracks with verified public-domain or royalty-free streaming URLs (Internet Archive audio URLs are acceptable). When the Jamendo API call fails, returns an empty result, or throws an error, the music service must return these fallback tracks instead of an empty array.

Update the useMusicSearch hook and Music page to handle the case where the API service returns an empty result by immediately rendering the fallback tracks rather than displaying an empty state or error message. The loading state should resolve correctly whether data comes from Jamendo or the fallback.
